status_vocabulary.externally_matched: Same intended estimand with a runnable FACETS comparison and explicit parameterization contract.
status_vocabulary.operationally_qualified: A host-specific execution route has passed explicit controls, completion gates, and failure-boundary tests.
status_vocabulary.formula_aligned: Formula or convention is aligned, but no sufficient FACETS golden-master evidence exists yet.
status_vocabulary.analogous: Similar user purpose, but implementation or estimand differs materially.
status_vocabulary.workbench_addition: Intentional capability beyond FACETS rather than a compatibility target.
status_vocabulary.unsupported: FACETS capability not implemented in the application.
status_vocabulary.unvalidated: Implementation exists locally but external FACETS evidence is not yet sufficient.

capabilities.capability: Windows FACETS 4.5.0 launch and output collection
capabilities.app_scope: Visible BATCH=NO subprocess adapter with stable nonempty report/Scorefile gates, graceful WM_CLOSE, and a 220-character prelaunch path budget
capabilities.facets_scope: Desktop GUI plus command-line specification/report execution
capabilities.evidence: validation/facets_visible_launcher_qualification_v2_20260811, validation/facets_shared_helper_qualification_20260811, validation/fx2_20260811, and validation/known_assignment_multivector_preflight4_20260811/v; official and historical controls passed and the short-path supplement calibrated 12/12 datasets with zero retries
capabilities.caveat: Host-specific hidden-window routes crash in XojoGUIFramework64.dll and are not qualified. FACETS must remain visible during automation. The 220-character limit is conservative operational protection, not a vendor-documented universal maximum. Forced termination is never success.

capabilities.app_scope: Person plus multiple additive facets, hard anchors, fit and diagnostics
capabilities.facets_scope: Standard many-facet JMLE
capabilities.evidence: validation/facets_450_complementary_mml_smoke_20260811; 12 direct-eligible runs, 108 parameters
capabilities.caveat: Externally matched only for the registered additive-RSM scope after matched centering, sign, hard-anchor, category-support, convergence, and structural-identifiability rules.

capabilities.app_scope: One selected step facet with a separate sum-to-zero threshold vector for each of its levels
capabilities.facets_scope: Models=?,?,?,#,R3 with Criterion as the partial-credit facet
capabilities.evidence: validation/facets_pcm_syntax_probe_20260811, validation/facets_pcm_pipeline_pilot20_20260811, validation/facets_pcm_boundary_pilot_20260811, validation/h6_design_replication100_v4_20260811, and validation/informative_assignment_confirmatory100_20260811; the complete-data 40-run pilot matched 360 main parameters and 240 thresholds, the fresh H6 replication passed 200/200 complete/planned-connected calibration pairs, and the fresh informative-assignment confirmation passed 200/200 planned/aligned calibration pairs
capabilities.caveat: Externally matched for the registered four-category JMLE PCM with Criterion as the sole step facet in complete balanced data, one ring-connected planned-missing design, and one fixed-density ability-severity-aligned stress design. These studies do not generalize to arbitrary missingness/sparsity, empirical MAR/MNAR mechanisms, named General/Specific scales, mixed supports, recoding, threshold anchors, more than one # facet, or raw fit parity.

capabilities.app_scope: Bounded GPCM estimation and approximate FACETS-style diagnostics
capabilities.facets_scope: Rasch-family response models; not a matched free-discrimination GPCM target
capabilities.evidence: Local tests only
capabilities.caveat: FACETS-style GPCM ZSTD is explicitly approximate and must not be labelled FACETS parity.

capabilities.app_scope: EM/direct/hybrid/auto MML, fixed/free population SD, latent regression, EAP
capabilities.facets_scope: FACETS standard estimation is JMLE/UCON/PMLE
capabilities.evidence: validation/operating_characteristics_anchor_fix_smoke_20260811/python_mml_*, validation/estimand_bridge_pilot_20260811, validation/estimand_distribution_confirmatory100_20260811, and validation/informative_assignment_confirmatory100_20260811; the shape study completed 1600/1600 fixed/free-SD Q31 fits and confirmed two free-SD shape contrasts, while the fresh fixed-density assignment study completed 400/400 MML fits and confirmed free/fixed Rater-RMSE increases of +0.09863/+0.06851, a free-SD change of -0.11839, and free/fixed severity-compression slopes of -0.48932/-0.38384
capabilities.caveat: This is a major complementary strength, not a FACETS compatibility claim or estimator ranking. Fixed and estimated SD are distinct estimands. The confirmed effects show sensitivity of normal-population MML in the registered generators and designs; they are not universal MML bias constants, do not identify empirical MAR/MNAR, and do not validate a missing-data correction. The heavy-tail shape direction passed Holm adjustment but narrowly missed its separate precision target.

capabilities.app_scope: Repository-only exact RSM/rectangular PCM core with WLE bridge
capabilities.facets_scope: Not the matched FACETS standard estimator
capabilities.evidence: Exact enumeration and immer cross-engine evidence plus validation/estimand_bridge_pilot_20260811; 16/16 RSM/PCM fits were conditionally rank-full, finite-MLE qualified, converged, and inference ready on complete and connected planned-missing rows
capabilities.caveat: Current public Streamlit workflow does not expose the full CMLE core. Conditional likelihood/AIC must not be compared numerically with JMLE or MML likelihood/AIC.

capabilities.app_scope: Join FACETS/Python JMLE, fixed/free-SD MML, and exact CMLE recovery on immutable RunIds with explicit likelihood-basis and estimand labels
capabilities.facets_scope: FACETS supplies the external JMLE calibration reference
capabilities.evidence: validation/estimand_bridge_pilot_20260811; 32 parent JMLE contracts and 48 new MML/CMLE fits produced 720 main-facet and 360 threshold recovery rows, with all 16 within-basis RSM-versus-PCM direction checks passing
capabilities.caveat: Two replicates establish orchestration and sensitivity signals only. Cross-estimator RMSE differences are not rankings, and joint, marginal, and conditional likelihood values are never compared across bases.

capabilities.app_scope: Generate paired normal, skewed, mixture, and heavy-tailed Person vectors at identical realized mean/SD; cross complete/planned-connected designs; fit FACETS/Python JMLE, fixed/free-SD MML, and exact CMLE with resumable attempt ledgers
capabilities.facets_scope: FACETS supplies the same-estimand JMLE calibration reference; MML and exact CMLE are complementary estimands
capabilities.evidence: validation/estimand_distribution_screening20_20260811, validation/estimand_distribution_confirmatory100_20260811, and validation/h6_design_replication100_v4_20260811; the 800-dataset confirmatory study ran 1600/1600 MML and 800/800 exact-CMLE fits and confirmed two free-SD shape contrasts. The separate H6 replication used fresh replicates 121-220, passed 100/100 native-precision Python pairs and 200/200 FACETS/Python JMLE calibration pairs, and reproduced the registered statistic independently in R 4.5.1
capabilities.caveat: The symmetric-mixture local-threshold screening pattern did not reproduce in JMLE, free-SD MML, or exact CMLE and must not become an automatic rule. The original H6 remains inconclusive at 99 pairs and its failed row was not replaced; the separate H6R result independently replicates one observation-design effect for the registered normal-Person heterogeneous-PCM DGM. Batch qualification is study-specific and does not establish universal missing-data bias or arbitrary sparse-design compatibility.

capabilities.app_scope: Hold rows, Raters per Person, per-Rater exposure, generated responses, category support, and constrained-design rank fixed while perturbing latent ability-by-Rater-severity assignment; report within-estimator Rater recovery, level compression, thresholds, and population-SD movement
capabilities.facets_scope: FACETS supplies same-estimand JMLE calibration for both sparse masks; MML and exact CMLE remain complementary estimands
capabilities.evidence: validation/informative_assignment_screening20_20260811 and validation/informative_assignment_confirmatory100_20260811; all 800/800 fresh confirmatory attempts were evidence-ready, FACETS/Python JMLE calibrated in 200/200 pairs with zero retries, the primary free-SD MML Rater-RMSE effect was +0.09863 with registered precision, and all four secondary directions passed Holm control. Base-R 4.5.1 independently rebuilt 500 endpoint contrasts and decisions within 3.55e-15
capabilities.caveat: The assignment rule uses known simulated Theta and true Rater severity. It is a sensitivity stressor, not an observed-data MAR/MNAR test, causal missingness model, correction method, or estimator leaderboard. Real-data use requires exogenous assignment information, positivity diagnostics, and a separately validated selection/correction contract.

capabilities.app_scope: Exact dense-DP sampling from a connected fixed-margin Person-Rater assignment family proportional to exp(gamma*T(G)), with common generated responses across gamma and JMLE/fixed-MML/free-MML/exact-CMLE lanes
capabilities.facets_scope: FACETS supplies a separately joined same-input JMLE calibration layer
capabilities.evidence: validation/known_assignment_multivector_preflight4_20260811/aggregate_visible_join_20260811 and validation/known_assignment_multivector_preflight4_20260811/r_verification_20260811; all 48 original attempts and 12/12 supplemental FACETS calibrations passed the derivative gate, all four registered n=4 directions advanced, and R 4.5.1 rebuilt 16 values and four summaries within 1.67e-16
capabilities.caveat: This is a four-vector nonconfirmatory preflight under a known simulated assignment law. It neither estimates assignment from observed data nor establishes a universal missingness bias, correction method, estimator ranking, or confirmation. These four vectors and prior screening data are excluded from any future confirmation.

capabilities.evidence: FACETS 4.5 output table index and corrected application crosswalk text

capabilities.app_scope: Category probabilities, information, thresholds, and category diagnostics
capabilities.facets_scope: Table 8 dichotomous/polytomous scale reports
capabilities.evidence: validation/facets_450_pilot20_table8_table13_v2_20260811, validation/facets_pcm_pipeline_pilot20_20260811, and validation/facets_pcm_boundary_pilot_20260811; RSM totals matched 640/640, complete PCM totals matched 320/320, and boundary-pilot PCM/RSM totals matched 144/144
capabilities.caveat: Threshold/count qualification covers the registered four-category additive RSM and the registered Criterion-specific PCM. Category Outfit remains displayed rather than raw; named scales, mixed supports, recoding, raw category-fit parity, and category-decision parity remain unvalidated.

capabilities.app_scope: Bias estimation, Holm/practical thresholds, conditional audits, interaction screens
capabilities.facets_scope: Bias models and Tables 9-14
capabilities.evidence: validation/facets_450_pilot20_table8_table13_v2_20260811; canonical arranged-by-N Table 13 parsed in 160/160 runs, 2292/2400 expected cells were reported, and all 1404 eligible Python/FACETS strong-decision mappings agreed, including 8 non-sparse flags; maximum absolute bias-size difference was 0.0092 logits
capabilities.caveat: Qualification is limited to the registered Rater-by-Task additive-RSM interaction and is not confirmatory false-positive or power evidence. Two nonconverged and 40 structurally unidentified runs were excluded; 108 extreme sparse cells are explicitly unavailable, not negative.

capabilities.app_scope: Exact constrained predictor-design rank/nullity, Person-Rater components, and InferenceReady distinct from optimizer convergence
capabilities.facets_scope: Iteration convergence, subset-connection wording, and optional connectivity-network output
